**Handbook:** a copy is available from the department office. The rules that matter most for a new TA:
- Working hours are Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00.
- Official events (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, committees, department meetings) are fixed. A cancellation counts only when the office confirms it in writing to the people concerned — "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough; ask me before relying on it.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments: don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one. Log every change.
- Meetings with your advisor go into your free time; TAs make time for their course's staff meetings.
